options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: URL to API endpint (without trailing slash). Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_ENDPOINT).

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the Vultr API. Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_KEY).

options.name: api_results_per_page
options.description: When receiving large numbers of resources, specify how many results should be returned per call to API. This does not determine how many results are returned; all resources are returned according to other filters. Vultr API maximum is 500. Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_RESULTS_PER_PAGE).

options.name: api_retries
options.description: Amount of retries in case of the Vultr API retuns an HTTP error code, such as - 429 Too Many Requests - 500 Internal Server Error - 504 Gateway Time-out Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_RETRIES).

options.name: api_retry_max_delay
options.description: Retry backoff delay in seconds is exponential up to this max. value, in seconds. Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_RETRY_MAX_DELAY).

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout to Vultr API. Fallback environment variable C(VULTR_API_TIMEOUT).

options.name: auto_ssl
options.description: The Auto SSL configuration. Must be using Vultr DNS for Auto SSL.

options.name: balancing_algorithm
options.description: The balancing algorithm.

options.name: firewall_rules
options.description: An array of firewall rule objects.

options.name: forwarding_rules
options.description: An array of forwarding rule objects.

options.name: global_regions
options.description: Array of Region ids to deploy child Load Balancers to.

options.name: health_check
options.description: The health check configuration.

options.name: http2
options.description: If true, this will enable HTTP2 traffic. You must have an HTTPS forwarding rule combo (HTTPS -> HTTPS) to enable this option.

options.name: http3
options.description: If true, this will enable HTTP3/QUIC traffic. You must have HTTP2 enabled.

options.name: instances
options.description: Array of Instance IDs to attach to this Load Balancer. Instances will be attached or detached to match your array.

options.name: label
options.description: The label for your Load Balancer.

options.name: nodes
options.description: The number of nodes to add to the load balancer (1-99), must be an odd number. Defaults to 1.

options.name: proxy_protocol
options.description: If true, you must configure backend nodes to accept Proxy protocol.

options.name: region
options.description: Region where the load balancer will be created.

options.name: ssl_redirect
options.description: If true, this will redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS. You must have an HTTPS rule and SSL certificate installed on the load balancer to enable this option.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the load balancer.

options.name: sticky_session
options.description: Enables sticky sessions for your load balancer when a cookie_name is provided.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The maximum time allowed for the connection to remain inactive before timing out in seconds. Defaults to 600.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate SSL certs of the Vultr API.

options.name: vpc
options.description: ID of the VPC you wish to use. If omitted, defaults to the public network.
